decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already specifies the RR-01 identifier in the internal-page header, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The existing same-message MODIFY already sets footer_report_identifier to RR-01, fully representing the identifier decision.
Changing the RR01 report identifier from PR-01 to RR-01 does not alter the report's premium visual-style requirement.
The report ID remains an editable customer field; specifying RR-01 for this report does not change the field-editability requirement.
The identifier correction does not change the dashboard's score content, heading, prominence, or communication goal.
The report-code correction does not affect the content or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The RR-01 identifier decision does not alter the final-page confidentiality warning or its visual treatment.
The displayed RR-01 report code does not change the required RR01–RR04 template variants, source editability, export support, or format selection.
Correcting the RR01 report's displayed identifier does not change how report variants map to customer score, risk band, or exposure level.
The report identifier correction does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their intended reuse.
